all event timestamps <= snapshot 2026-10-30 18:00:00 (bid deadlines excepted)
requester employed on the request submission date
RFQ issued >= request submitted; due > issued; evaluated >= due
quote submitted within the RFQ bid window; valid_until >= submission
approval requested after submission (and after evaluation for awards); decided >= requested
PO issued after every request it fulfils (and after RFQ evaluation)
supplier status history is contiguous (half-open intervals)
request_line total = quantity x estimated unit price
request estimated_total = sum of its lines
quote_line amount = quantity x unit price
quote goods = sum of lines; total = goods + freight
quote_evaluation recomputes (FX of quote month, duty rule, landed cost, eligibility)
landed_cost_rank is the rank among eligible quotes
po_line amount = quantity x unit price; quantity and item = request line
RFQ PO lines, prices, quantities and freight equal the awarded quote lines
direct PO prices = list price x (1 - supplier contract discount)
po_line qty_received = sum of accepted delivery quantities; status consistent
delivery_line accepted + rejected = delivered; reason iff rejected
delivery on-time / days late / completes_po / sequence recompute
PO status consistent with line receipt status
budget_balance = allocation + sum of ledger deltas (available = allocated - reserved - committed)
transfers net to zero (contingency out = department in)
every transfer is backed by an APPROVED budget exception of the same amount
reservation = estimate at submission; held while open, fully released once ordered/rejected/cancelled
after award the reservation is re-based to the awarded landed cost
PO commitment = total_usd, less the open balance released on short close
every request, RFQ, quote and PO has a creation event
event chains are continuous and time-ordered (from_status = previous to_status)
approval tier = threshold band of the approval basis (APR-T1..T4)
approval thresholds enforced: completed chains cover every level the tier requires
approvers hold the required authority and never approve their own request
approval steps are sequential (next step routed when the previous is approved)
budget exception approvals exist only for requests that failed the budget check
quotes come from invited suppliers; quotes_received = quotes = QUOTED invitations
invited suppliers serve the category and were ACTIVE without HIGH risk at issue
approved competitive awards rest on >= 3 quotes or a waiver; single source has a justification approval
every exception has a reason: decisions, cancellations, disqualifications, register rows, awards
request lines belong to the request category and use the item unit of measure
request charged to its department budget of the category budget type
sourcing route follows SRC-1 and an RFQ exists exactly for RFQ routes
no label-like columns in input tables
every label references an existing record
JSON files have the same rows and columns as CSV
schema.sql + seed.sql load into SQLite with FK enforcement; counts match CSV
